subject: Residential Zoning Relief Applications
overview: The board evaluated three residential zoning requests involving building height and setback non-conformities. While the board approved vertical additions on Monument and Gaston Streets, it continued a proposal for a two-family conversion on 2nd Street to address concerns regarding story limits and building massing.

items.title: 121 2nd Street Two-Family Conversion
items.summary: The board continued the application to replace a single-family home with a two-family structure to August 28th to allow for plan revisions. The Building Commissioner and board requested that the applicant redesign the third floor to clearly comply with the 2.5-story limit and provide updated stormwater management details for pervious surfaces.

items.title: 125 Monument Street Third-Story Addition
items.summary: Approved a special permit and variance to add a third floor via dormers and extend a non-conforming side yard setback at 125 Monument Street. The board found that the narrow and elongated shape of the lot justified the variance and noted significant support from the surrounding neighbors.

items.title: 268 Gaston Street Vertical Addition
items.summary: Approved a special permit to raise the roof and add a second story within the existing building footprint at 268 Gaston Street. The project extends an existing side yard setback non-conformity of seven feet but was deemed to have no substantial detriment to the neighborhood character.

items.title: Administrative Items and Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the June 26, 2025, meeting minutes with minor corrections and received an update that new members are expected to be appointed before the August meeting.
